_comment: INTERIM credential file (Phase 1). Copy to credentials.json (git-ignored) and fill in real API keys. Phase 1 hardening replaces this with AWS Secrets Manager (boto3). Each key maps a LOCAL cluster name (matching es_clusters.json) to its auth. Use an Elasticsearch API key: the 'api_key' value is the base64 'id:api_key' string that goes in the 'Authorization: ApiKey <...>' header.
